title: Unifying Consciousness and Time to Enhance Artificial Intelligence
reasoning: The paper is a theoretical study proposing a framework for integrating consciousness and time perception into AI. While it includes a dedicated section discussing the importance of human ethics, cultural values, and belief systems (such as horoscopes and religious mappings of the sky) for 'responsible AI,' it does not perform an empirical evaluation or benchmarking of these aspects, nor does it address Large Language Models.
